Every program in this chapter has the same three steps.
Clock times are awkward to subtract. Turn each one into **minutes since midnight** first.
You walk s metres at v metres per minute and must arrive by 08:00, with 10 minutes spare. When do you leave?
Time problems: convert to minutes, compute, then convert back with `/ 60` and `% 60`. Going back past midnight needs `(t % 1440 + 1440) % 1440`. This is P1425 and P5707.
Three sides are enough to find a triangle's area.
What each verdict means, and a checklist before you submit.
The judge runs your program on hidden tests. Each verdict points to a different kind of mistake, so read it before you change any code.

text: cerr prints to your screen but not into the answer the judge reads.
Debug values go to `cerr`, so the judge never sees them. Still remove them before you submit: printing takes time.
Samples pass but a hidden test is WA? It is usually an edge case or overflow. Make a tiny test you can solve by hand, and compare.
